TOOL_RESULT get_schema:
{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE refunds (refund_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, item_id INTEGER,
    refund_amount_twd INTEGER, refund_ts TEXT, reason_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, carrier TEXT,
    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "語意層沒有命中「配送天數」，我先抽樣 shipments 與 orders 的時間欄位格式，確認時間字串格式與 UTC 儲存假設，再決定如何計算天數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT s.shipment_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts, typeof(s.delivered_ts) AS t FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id LIMIT 10"}}

{"thought": "依語意層的時區規則，以台北時間（UTC+8）劃分 2025 年第二季，用訂單時間歸屬；配送天數取 delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts。同時回傳筆數與未送達筆數，檢查資料完整性。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_total, COUNT(s.delivered_ts) AS n_delivered, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'"}}

response: {"thought": "平均值只計入已送達的 9921 筆，但我還沒檢查負值、空的出貨時間或一單多筆出貨的重複計算，先做這些驗證再交付。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN s.shipped_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null_shipped, SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivered_ts < s.shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_negative, MIN(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)) AS max_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'"]}}
